summary: Add bounded opt-in Git change publication and build/review stage claims

replay.detail: No new replicated claim kind, binding field, replay or history scan.

schema.detail: Uses existing local record index and owner-runtime work projections.

rules.detail: Explicitly enabled owner-runtime agent mutations check exact durable work claim, attempt, live incarnation and current lease again before atomic Git publication. Main and landing authority remain with the curator.

compatibility.detail: Adds changes create/ready/draft/claim/release, bounded work-binding read and control.work mutation route. New mutations_enabled defaults false.

downtime.detail: No activation, pruning or live stack migration.

manual.detail: Operator must explicitly enable same-runtime pilot, name its start, and retain PR fallback. Creation stops at 100 distinct changes or 14 days; every ref increase must fit 5000 managed change/evidence refs. Landing, takeover, dependency composition and pruning are outside this adapter.

recovery.detail: Voluntary release requires exact worker/work/nonce and remains possible after pilot expiry. Unknown, conflicting or unindexed Git data cannot authorize a write; uncertain push results require explicit inspection.
